mathematics.assertion_tested: Both normalized nodes have nonsquare branch factor over F49; all six nonzero equation residues give the same normalized fiber; the carry identity for the unit-Kummer extension is associative.
mathematics.conventions: Arithmetic Frobenius49 fixes each node and exchanges its branches; polynomials use ascending coefficients.
non_claims: No computational proof of uniformization, node thickness, monodromy comparison, finite-flat descent, or irreducibility.
